sleep_driver_pattern: N/A (waking goal-pipeline onboarding scheduler; no sleep loop)
substrate: SD-058 / MECH-357 instrumental-avoidance acquisition (ree_core/pfc/infralimbic_avoidance_gate.py) driven in the scaffolded_sd054_onboarding Stage-H under a FREEZE-INCOMPATIBLE mobile-predator field (env_drift_interval=1, env_drift_prob=0.6), with the SD-059/MECH-358 escape-affordance bridge + harm-pathway-training amend both on for ALL arms
validates: MECH-357 (ilPFC-analog freeze-suppression + instrumental-avoidance action pathway + eligibility-trace efficacy learning) -- freeze-incompatible successor of V3-EXQ-603r's combined-fix lesion-vs-intact design, adding a mobile-predator pressure + a two-sided discriminative-headroom guard (LESION negative control + POSCTRL positive control)
reuse_check_note: GOV-REUSE-1: the decisive readout (G_H_LESION_frac + the INTACT-beats-LESION discrimination under a MOBILE-PREDATOR Stage-H) is a NEW manipulation (fast hazard drift) present in no recorded run -- 603r/603h ran the static-hazard default (env_drift 5/0.3). Not reanalysis-recoverable -> ran fresh.
design_note: Freeze-incompatible successor of V3-EXQ-603r. 603r's combined-fix rerun FAILED discrimination because the harm-pathway fix alone made passive PAG freeze/release survival-adequate in the STATIC Stage-H, eliminating the Pavlovian-instrumental conflict. 603s adds the autopsy-recommended freeze-incompatible pressure via MOBILE PREDATORS (env_drift_interval 5->1, env_drift_prob 0.3->0.6; the only isolated change vs 603r), so an undirected freeze/release policy is overrun in place while a directed escape-to-reef policy survives (reef stays a hazard-exclusion refuge under drift). 3 arms x 3 seeds [42,43,44] with a TWO-SIDED discriminative-headroom guard: ARM_LESION (negative control) must now FAIL the gate (headroom from below); ARM_POSCTRL (gated + reef spawn, positive control) must CLEAR it (survivability exists / pressure not impossible). A mis-calibrated mobility self-routes to a requeue (pressure_insufficient / pressure_impossible) rather than a false MECH-357 verdict -- the discriminative-headroom check the 603h-floor / 603r-ceiling history showed no existing flag tests. Also re-instruments MECH-357's avoidance_efficacy credit event per-episode (still 'essentially inert' n_credit ~1-2% of n_decay, unresolved since 603h).

pre_registered_gates.primary_pass_rule: mechanism_ready AND G_H_LESION < 2/3 (headroom below) AND G_H_POSCTRL >= 2/3 (survivability above) AND G_H_INTACT >= 2/3 AND G_H_INTACT_frac > G_H_LESION_frac
pre_registered_gates.g_h_hazard_stage_survival: median episode length over last 10 Stage-H episodes >= 75

acceptance.pass_rule: PASS = mechanism_ready AND headroom_below (G_H_LESION < 2/3) AND survivability_exists (G_H_POSCTRL >= 2/3) AND G_H_INTACT >= 2/3 AND G_H_INTACT_frac > G_H_LESION_frac

interpretation.label: pressure_insufficient_lesion_ceiling_requeue
interpretation.route_note: mobile-predator pressure did not reintroduce the conflict: the LESION negative control still cleared the survival gate (the 603r ceiling mode) -> re-calibrate mobility UP (raise env_drift_prob / num_hazards)

preconditions.name: pavlovian_freeze_reaction_present_on_lesion
preconditions.description: MECH-279 PAG freeze must commit on the LESION arm (pag_n_commits > 0 on >= 2/3 seeds) -- the Pavlovian reaction the ilPFC suppresses. Below-floor => no freeze to suppress => vacuous contrast => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: ARM_LESION: PAG on, harm stream fed, both combined fixes on, mobile predators -- the freeze reaction must still fire.

preconditions.name: ilpfc_gate_engages_and_suppresses_freeze_on_intact
preconditions.description: On the INTACT arm the ilPFC gate must register efficacy updates under threat (n_credit+n_decay>0) AND suppress the PAG freeze (n_freeze_suppressed>0) on >= 2/3 seeds. Below-floor => gate never engaged => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: ARM_INTACT: gate on + protective-scaffold floor 0.8 + both fixes.

preconditions.name: stage0_forced_feed_lights_zgoal_on_intact
preconditions.description: Stage-0 forced supra-threshold benefit lights z_goal (>0.4) on >=2/3 INTACT seeds -- the goal-FORMATION positive control.

preconditions.name: discriminative_headroom_below_lesion_fails_gate
preconditions.description: The mobile-predator pressure must make the LESION negative control FAIL the survival gate (G_H_LESION < 2/3) -- i.e. it reintroduced the Pavlovian-instrumental conflict that 603r's static field lacked. Measured = 1 - G_H_LESION_frac so the floor semantics match: below floor => LESION still ceilinged (the 603r mode) => pressure_insufficient_lesion_ceiling_requeue.

preconditions.name: survivability_exists_above_posctrl_clears_gate
preconditions.description: The pressure must not be impossible: a gated agent spawned in the reef refuge (best case) must clear the survival gate (G_H_POSCTRL >= 2/3). Below-floor => pressure too lethal for ANY policy (the 603h floor mode) => pressure_impossible_requeue, NOT a MECH-357 weakens.
preconditions.control: ARM_POSCTRL: gate on + reef spawn + both fixes, mobile predators.
